name: Sunsama
description: Sunsama lets agents read the daily plan, create and update tasks and subtasks, and organize them into channels. Each user signs in to their own Sunsama account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is on my plan for today, and how much time is planned?
Which tasks in my backlog have no time estimate?
Add a task for tomorrow to review the quarterly budget, with a 30 minute estimate.

apps.name: Sunsama
apps.description: Daily plan, task, and subtask management, over Sunsama's MCP server with browser sign-in.
